verdicts.evidence: The page gives no clock times; it says only 'every forty minutes between early morning and late evening', 'one boat each hour' and 'before dusk', and its last line says printed timetables are kept in the shelter at each landing.
Paragraph 3 says 'the last crossing leaves the quay before dusk' without naming which stop, while paragraph 1 names both the 'north landing' and the 'market quay'.
Paragraph 1 gives the every-forty-minutes pattern, paragraph 2 covers bicycles and paragraph 3 gives the winter timetable, with no subheads under the heading 'Notes for ferry passengers'.
